Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614227 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join activities to assays on assay_id, join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
